_readme: Curated listings — edit by hand; the daily workflow never touches this file. Fields: id, status (active|pending|sold), price (number), address, city, neighborhood (optional), beds, baths, sqft, lot (optional, sq ft), type (Single Family|Townhouse|Condo|Multi-Family), year (optional), photo (optional path under assets/img/listings/), url (optional MLS/Zillow/brochure link), blurb, date (ISO list or sale date), sample (true shows a 'Sample' badge; for layout previews only). Copy _example into items to add a home.

_example.blurb: One or two sentences about the home.
